text1: A lightweight, agile dogfighter favored by Protectorate fleet pickets. Built around a swiveling gimbal gunpod and reinforced thruster housings, Chela wings excel at darting through dense flak screens to intercept incoming torpedoes and harass hostile strike craft.

Reinforced by Blackcollar technicians with laminated boron-carbide armor and heavy maneuvering jets. While slightly slower than regular fleet models, its enhanced survivability enables it to hold point-blank interception vectors amidst heavy capital flak.

A stripped-down civilian security variant commonly operated by mining guilds and orbital port militias. Lacking militarized avionics, it compensates with simplified flight controls and affordable maintenance overhead.
Upgraded by the elite Skytiger Guard with high-output flux conduits and an up-gunned heavy ballistic cannon, transforming the agile Chela into a lethal space-superiority duelist.
Refitted by the Tichel Mercantile Concern with enhanced long-range telemetry, sensor suites, and high-efficiency drive coils to serve as armed convoy scouts and reconnaissance escorts.

A testament to both the recklessness and the ingenuity of the Herd's scavengers, the Goforth battlecarrier is an aggressive amalgam of salvaged hulls, reinforced with thick slabs of scrap metal and supercharged by volatile geothermal fuel feeds. It plunges directly into the brawl to deploy endless swarms of raiders.

Crude, slow, and armored well beyond need or reason, the Stave is a brutal delivery system for a sawed-off Heavy Flenser, designed to simply chop rival strikecraft in half with a point-blank storm of explosive slugs.

An advanced point-defense drone designed to accompany Magellan patrol gunships, maintaining a continuous defensive perimeter of proximity-fused flak bursts to shield allied vessels from incoming missile barrages.
A civilian-rated space-superiority fighter utilized by planetary customs patrols, boasting respectable shielding, responsive maneuvering thrusters, and dependable close-quarters armament.

The heavy backbone of Protectorate carrier strike wings. Powerful, fast, and shielded against intense counter-fire, the Jitte is capable of surviving sustained brawls around enemy cruisers and capital ships to deliver decisive close-range ordnance.
Refitted by the Blackcollars for planetary assault and shock warfare, this heavy fighter mounts hardened ballistic sponsons and heavy-duty armor to provide crushing close air support.
Scavenged and repurposed by the Herd, this modified Jitte trades long-term hull safety for an aggressive, missile-heavy alpha strike configuration that overwhelms targets before they can retaliate.
Customized by the Tichel Concern as a multirole escort fighter, blending beam precision with extended patrol endurance to safeguard high-value merchant convoys across the sector.

A heavily armored strike bomber deploying twin bays for electron bombs. While not matching the raw kinetic blast of conventional torpedoes, its devastating EMP arcs leave enemy ships crippled and ripe for follow-up fleet strikes.
The Skytiger variant replaces standard electron ordnance with flux-primed fusion bombs, delivering crushing anti-armor thermal devastation on targeted capital hulls.
Outfitted by the Tichel Concern with rocket grenade bays for sustained saturation bombardment against pirate hideouts and asteroid encampments.
A tough, heavily protected escort corvette designed to anchor fighter screens and suppress enemy missile salvos with flexible autocannon turrets and anti-fighter ordnance.
An aggressive strike corvette armed with a high-intensity fusion lance and anti-fighter missiles, engineered to spearhead assault runs and carve through the armor of hostile cruisers.
Outfitted with precision beam projectors and defensive flares, serving as a steadfast line escort for vulnerable trade convoys across contested jump-points.

A vicious and highly agile attack drone utilizing forbidden machine reflexes to overwhelm targets with precise energy bursts. Few unaugmented pilots have tangled with a Swarmfighter wing and lived to tell the tale.
A nimble insurgent strike craft equipped with afterburners and omni-shields, delivering cluster munitions in hit-and-run attacks against state infrastructure.
A tough, well-protected attack corvette armed with a powerful turret and anti-armor missiles, refitted by the Blackcollars as a dedicated assault gunship against fortified targets.
A heavily armored standoff bomber deploying twin missile bays, allowing Blackcollar strike wings to bombard defended targets from outside point-defense killzones.
A rugged support fighter wielding a heavy nose-mounted Bonethrower Cannon, capable of breaking open derelict hulls and pirate skiffs.
An armored support fighter deploying a High Intensity Cutting Laser and defensive flak mines, modified to keep frontal threats at bay through massed laser fire and a thick screen of flak pods.
A heavily modified Jitte-class strike fighter created by renegade engineer Tai Cor-Lan, featuring extra thrusters, an upgraded main cannon, underslung autoguns, and powerful fuel injectors.
Powerful, fast, and heavily shielded, this heavy fighter is customized by the Marauders to deliver a devastating first-strike punch in close quarters.
A heavily modified Bastardsword corvette created by Tai Cor-Lan, boasting reinforced armor, an altered lance, an enormous underslung cannon, and coordinated wing telemetry.
A tough, well-protected attack corvette armed with a deadly fragmentation shotgun and armor-stripping missiles, modified by the Marauders for endurance and attrition.
A reconditioned Bastardsword corvette modified to serve the Leveller cause, equipped with modular flux systems and advanced command software to coordinate a wing of swarmfighter drones.
An automated fire-control drone equipped with high-resolution rangefinders and a low-powered point-defense maser to augment the gunnery of its host vessel.
A field-modified targeting drone gutted and redesigned for fire support, mounting auxiliary armor, a light autocannon, and an upgraded point-defense emitter.
A highly maneuverable strikecraft with an extremely flexible loadout, adapted by insurgent salvagers from ancient heavy fighter frames to mount diverse missile and ballistic payloads.
An automated defense drone platform equipped with light weapons and its own dedicated drone fighter wing for perimeter security.
A wing of automated bomber drones, heavily armored and equipped with a high-capacity internal bomb bay.
A wing of automated gun drones, heavily armored and equipped with twin-linked machine guns for relentless anti-fighter screening.
A compact automated defense drone armed with a versatile mix of light cannons to harass incoming bombers.
A sub-frigate automated defense drone armed with guided missiles and ballistic weaponry for autonomous sector interdiction.
A heavy automated defense drone armed with diverse weaponry and protected by a Damper Field generator for sustained area defense.
An automated long-range orbital defense platform armed with a single heavy capital-grade weapon mount.
An advanced point-defense drone modified by Dunerunner smugglers to provide localized screening and sensor masking during illicit transit operations.
A lightweight loitering missile drone capable of extended area denial and equipped with a low-powered point-defense maser.
An experimental aerospace frame adapted from luxury exploratory craft, rebuilt with military-grade armor plates and modular weapons hardpoints.

Surpassingly ugly and equally effective; a battlecruiser design that foregoes all attempt at subtlety in favor of raw frontal firepower, built around a huge spinal fusion lance and backed up by an impressive array of ballistics and a single flight deck. These ships represent an aggressive engagement philosophy for the doctrinaire Magellan Fleet.

Nothing more than a titanic slab of composite armor pocked by engine nozzles and massive gun emplacements, these immense warships are the Magellan Fleet's raison d'etre—the heavy triphammers meant to smash an enemy's battle-line into glowing clouds of slag, gas, and shoals of twisted metal fragments.
A tried-and-true fleet carrier design, armed defensively but exceptionally capable of maintaining sustained fighter wings and long-range missile fire support across extended campaigns.

Through a remarkable feat of clandestine engineering, the Levellers have rebuilt the Hager-class supply hull into a high-capacity drone carrier. While lightly armored, the overwhelming waves of automated strike craft it can unleash make it a pivotal asset in revolutionary operations.

Simple, durable, and rugged, these armed freighters are heavily weighted toward the 'combat' side. While not the equal of dedicated line cruisers, woe betide the pirates who find themselves caught between the crossed arcs of their heavy gun turrets.

A heavily modified Talley-class merchantman operated by the Dunerunners. Outfitted with smuggled high-end subsystems from across the Sector, reinforced cargo shielding, and concealed weapons sponsons, it presents a formidable challenge to customs patrols.

A solid, unyielding line cruiser, this veteran design is essentially unchanged from the first models rushed out to defend the Khamn system during the First AI War. What it lacks in speed, it makes up for in stubborn durability and dependable firepower.

Unusual for a Magellan design, this swift and mobile combatant emphasizes aggressive alpha strikes and sports a reinforced armored prow for ramming maneuvers. Captains are cautioned to keep threats forward, where its armor is thickest.

Fresh from the nanoforge with the latest improvements in Protectorate metallurgy, this Blackcollar refit of the Capella sports a radar-absorbent stealth coating and an experimental neural interface for razor-sharp combat response.

An extraordinary skunkworks vessel created in secret for the Levellers, incorporating a retrofitted Sigma Reaction Furnace, advanced shielding, multi-beam PD nodes, and an integrated Magnetic Hypergun for astonishing acrobatic mobility and firepower.

A modern, high-end frigate design engineered to shore up the traditional weakness of Magellan skirmishing lines. Its most distinctive asset is an advanced companion flak drone that provides superb point-defense coverage.
A militarized heavy tanker converted from the Phillips hull. Strictly regulated by the Protectorate, these tankers are vital to maintaining fleet operational range across the Persean Sector.
An ancient modular escort craft renowned for its low maintenance overhead and flexible weapons layout, serving as a reliable workhorse across all echelons of the Magellan Fleet.

These ponderous ancient craft were the command vessels of the original exile fleet that led the Magellan refugees across the void. Cavernous internal bays house dormant autoforges, relic technology, and historical archives of immense value.

A painstakingly restored colonial mothership operated by the Tichel Mercantile Concern, housing industrial-scale fabrication suites and extensive logistics arrays to spearhead deep-space commercial expansion.
A simple and utterly disposable drone corvette utilized by the Levellers as a combat screen, requiring minimal crew thanks to clandestine automation suites.
An agile insurgent corvette armed with a spinal energy lance, designed to harass enemy flanks and deliver precision strikes against vulnerable logistics ships.
A modern, well-balanced light cruiser emphasizing long-range reconnaissance, responsive maneuvering, and versatile weapons coverage, rapidly replacing aging hulls in frontier patrol service.
A stolid, brick-shaped brawler built for outright brawling at short-to-medium ranges, boasting versatile weapons mounts and heavy composite armor belts.
A battle-tested frigate that has seen continuous service since the First AI War. Though conservatively armed, its rugged hull construction makes it remarkably tenacious in a line engagement.
The backbone of independent trade in the Khamn cluster, this durable light freighter offers superior hull protection compared to standard civilian transports, ensuring cargo arrives intact.
An up-armored variant of the light freighter featuring augmented turret mounts and reinforced shielding to deter opportunistic raiders in hazardous fringe systems.
A long-range patrol destroyer equipped with an integrated fighter bay, advanced sensor arrays, and high-capacity fuel bunkerage, excelling at extended anti-piracy sweeps.
A customized Kant scout destroyer operated by Dunerunner smugglers, featuring specialized planetary survey gear, concealed cargo holds, and reinforced missile sponsons.
Adapted from early Protectorate phase-cloak testbed platforms, this imposing heavy cruiser uses its phase coils to position devastating ballistic and energy batteries into vulnerable enemy flanks.
A durable phase frigate notable for its outsized bow mount and modular internal framing, allowing pilots to ambush heavier combatants before slipping back into the phase realm.
Slow, bulky, heavily armored, and largely defenseless; penal logistics crews have maintained these rugged supply ships for centuries, outliving generations of the malcontents who crewed them.
A dedicated fleet artillery platform built with an unusual asymmetric hull that houses a monstrous missile installation, delivering devastating long-range barrages.
Tough, swift, and armed to the teeth; a mainstay of Magellan patrol operations whose forward firing arc represents a lethal killzone for any frigate foolish enough to approach.
A versatile combat frigate equipped with an afterburning propulsion pack, ideal for fast pursuit, picket duty, and dynamic flanking maneuvers.
A light carrier conversion of the Talley merchant hull that replaces main cargo bays with a flight deck and missile autoloader, proven through centuries of combat service.
Favored by Blackcollar shock assault units, this converted carrier blends rapid flight deck cycling with devastating short-range missile barrages to support orbital breach operations.
A heavily modified Edger carrier created by Tai Cor-Lan, replacing a flight deck with a heavy ballistic hardpoint, integrating a massive missile array, and launching customized Lochaber strike wings.

An antiquated, temperamental armed merchant schooner. While demanding to maintain, its spacious cargo bays, respectable armament, and surprising agility make it a cherished classic among veteran spacers.
A rugged civilian runabout unique to Magellan space, armored and armed to a standard that rivals military patrol craft in more civilized sectors.
A prestigious clipper combining high cruise speed, generous reactor performance, and elegant lines, traditionally awarded by the High Protector as patronage rewards to distinguished captains.
An ancient escort fighter built for exclusive use with the Mallory clipper, combining blistering speed with generous missile payloads for general-purpose space superiority.
An ancient heavy support fighter designed for the Mallory clipper, featuring thick shielding and heavy armor to threaten enemy destroyers and frigates.
An inventive Leveller conversion of the Rounder heavy fighter into a high-speed strike bomber, deploying cluster munitions in hit-and-run raids.
An expertly rebuilt Blackcollar variant of the Rounder, upgraded with modern avionics and long-range missile launchers to provide continuous fire support from carrier decks.
A colossal relic warship predating the Domain's arrival in the Persean Sector. Mounting ancient spinal lances and thick composite armor slabs, it remains a terrifying force on the modern battlefield.
A compact pod for Balefire heavy fusion missiles, requiring strike craft to redock for replenishment once its ammunition is expended.

A launch tube for Balefire heavy fusion missiles. While lacking the sheer kinetic penetration of heavy torpedoes, the Balefire delivers intense thermal energy that severely stresses shields and burns exposed armor.
A medium launch system for Balefire fusion missiles, holding generous reloads in an armored carousel for sustained long-range bombardment.
A capital-grade launch battery for Balefire heavy fusion missiles, housing a vast internal magazine to maintain unrelenting missile pressure across extended fleet engagements.
An internal magazine of Balefire fusion missiles with an articulated launcher arm, enabling strike craft to acquire and engage targets from any angle.
A large-caliber smoothbore cannon firing a scattering blast of high-explosive canister shells, devastating exposed hulls and lightly armored vessels at medium range.
A compact fragmentation shotgun that flings an explosive core surrounded by a swarm of semi-molten shrapnel, tearing apart damaged armor belts and exposed internal compartments.
A lightweight fragmentation shotgun integrated into strike craft mounts, delivering lethal bursts against unshielded targets.
A heavy, hard-hitting autocannon that fires massive semi-molten penetrators. The heavy kinetic-thermal slugs punch through thick armor belts with brutal efficiency.
A lightened Bonethrower cannon integrated into fighter fuselages, trading sustained fire rate for exceptional single-shot punch.
A twin-mount heavy autocannon firing linked salvos of semi-molten bolts. The heavy cast-iridium turret housing provides excellent stability and crew protection during ferocious line brawls.
An electrostatic autogun that fires rapid bursts of charged flechettes, tearing through exposed hull plating and overwhelming point-defense screens at close quarters.
A compact Bonechipper autogun firing charged flechette bursts, optimized for high-speed interceptor dogfights.
A twin-barrel electrostatic cannon coupling reliable flechette feed mechanisms with high-torque traversing motors for responsive brawling fire.
A twin-linked fighter turret that delivers rapid flechette salvos to shred enemy strike wings.
A triple-mount electrostatic cannon delivering massive volume of fire to overwhelm hostile armor and point defense.
A quad-barrel turret housing dual-loading Boneshaker mechanisms, unleashing thunderous flechette salvos nicknamed the 'Valca Piano' across close-range brawls.
A customized heavy autocannon firing overcharged kinetic slugs that generate violent EMP arcs across target weapons and engines on impact.
A large-caliber smoothbore artillery piece firing high-velocity explosive rounds to breach thick armor at long range, aided by a specialized autoloader.
A massive spinal beam emitter integrated into the Hermann battlecruiser, projecting an intense particle beam that incinerates armor and hull across extreme ranges.
Fires rapid salvos of high-velocity kinetic rockets to overwhelm enemy shields during fighter attack runs.
A compact rocket rack firing high-velocity kinetic projectiles designed to rapidly overload hostile shield generators.
A medium rocket launcher discharging dense kinetic salvos that severely stress shield emitters and force defensive venting.
A rugged, extended-range pulse laser unit rated for ship-to-ship combat, prized for its reliability and thermal endurance.
Launches a salvo of four anti-fighter missiles with proximity-fused fragmentation warheads to clear interceptor screens.
A fighter-mounted pod launching two anti-fighter fragmentation missiles.
Fires a double salvo of four anti-fighter fragmentation missiles to swat down incoming strike craft.
A single-tube launcher for an anti-fighter fragmentation missile.
A hull-integrated launch system for Stormfire cluster missiles, holding massive internal reloads and supported by a slow-cycle munitions nanoforge.
An integrated missile battery firing Balefire heavy fusion missiles, sustained by an internal fabrication suite for continuous long-range bombardment.
Launches a pair of high-yield electron torpedoes that release violent EMP discharge cascades across target hulls, disabling weapons and engines.
Fires an unstable plasma torpedo that detonates into a devastating EMP arc upon hull impact.
A strike craft payload delivering high-yield electron torpedoes to disable heavy combatants.
A synchronized bomber bay launching 900-range electron torpedoes to paralyze capital ship flux conduits.
A heavy bomb bay holding massive unguided explosive warheads that rely on the launch ship's velocity to strike targets.
A lightweight energy bolter effective against fighters and lightly armored hulls.
A compact EMP missile designed to disable point defense and knock out enemy engines.
A dependable machine gun firing heavy slugs at high velocity to swat down enemy strike craft.
Twin-linked machine guns firing high-rate kinetic slugs for interceptor dogfights.
A compact bay for flux-primed fusion bombs, capable of inflicting heavy thermal damage on capital armor.
A synchronized bomber bay launching 900-range fusion bombs to incinerate heavy armor belts in a single synchronized strike.
An array of heavy launch racks discharging massive, flux-primed fusion bombs to carpet target areas in thermonuclear fire.
A heavy discharger for enormous fusion bombs capable of cracking the heaviest armor plates.
A massive, low-velocity artillery cannon firing heavy siege shells at extreme range. Detonations create massive blast waves that damage nearby escorts.
A twin-barrel burst flak projector designed for supplemental point defense against missile swarms.
Discharges high-speed kinetic rockets armed with electron compression charges to stress shields and disable onboard electronics simultaneously.

An enormous direct-energy microwave projector adapted from ancient orbital power arrays. While largely ineffective against modern shields, hits on exposed hull produce ruinous electrical surges that fry internal electronics.
A heavy rotary cannon in an armored housing, firing high-rate explosive shells to shred incoming missiles, fighters, and light frigates.
A compact rotary cannon mounted on strike craft, providing fierce anti-missile and anti-fighter firepower.
A high-velocity rotary autocannon that hammers enemy shields with relentless salvos of kinetic cluster shells.
A heavy plasma torch firing concentrated bursts of ultra-hot plasma to melt through composite armor and hull plates.
Three synchronized maser emitters linked to an integrated predictive tracking computer, swiftly neutralizing incoming missile salvos at low flux cost.
A modular heavy fusion cannon developed by the Skytiger Guard, delivering devastating thermal alpha strikes to counter heavy enemy line combatants.
An oversized beam lance integrated into heavy strike craft power conduits to shear armor during high-speed attack runs.
A massive spinal magnetic accelerator firing hypervelocity slugs that stress shields and spall into lethal fragments behind penetrated armor.
An advanced magnetic cannon firing high-velocity slugs with pinpoint accuracy, devastating enemy shields and creating deadly interior spalling.
A fighter-mounted bay launching salvos of light, fast short-range missiles to chip away at enemy armor belts.
A compact launcher discharging rapid salvos of five fast short-range missiles to overwhelm hostile point defense.
A medium missile pod firing ten rapid short-range missiles in sustained saturation barrages.
A heavy fifteen-tube short-range missile launcher delivering overwhelming saturation salvos in close-quarters brawls.
A revolver-breech grenade launcher firing high-explosive charges in rapid succession to breach damaged armor.
A strike craft grenade launcher firing explosive canisters into enemy hulls during strafing runs.
A battery of small rifled cannons firing synchronized salvos of explosive shells at medium range.
Launches agile anti-fighter missiles equipped with proximity-fused explosive warheads.
An armored rotary point-defense cannon firing rapid explosive shells to intercept incoming torpedoes and strike craft.
A lightweight rotary cannon for strikecraft point defense and strafing runs.
A carousel-style rotary autocannon with individually recoiling barrels, delivering exceptional accuracy and sustained kinetic shield pressure.
A compact plasma torch firing sustained bursts of superheated plasma that rapidly devour exposed armor plates.
A high-efficiency microwave emitter that rapidly detonates incoming missiles at virtually zero flux cost.
A dependable lightweight pulse laser commonly fitted to civilian and escort vessels across Magellan space.
An accurate, long-range autocannon allowing smaller combatants to apply consistent kinetic pressure from long distances.
A launch rack of high-speed dumbfire torpedoes with blistering terminal velocity to punch through point-defense screens.
A single-tube launcher for a high-speed dumbfire torpedo.
An internal tube launching high-speed dumbfire torpedoes in rapid succession.
A simple magnetic rail cannon firing unusually large, dense kinetic slugs to batter hostile shields.
A heavy battery of magnetic rail cannons firing synchronized salvos of dense kinetic penetrators.
Fires two heavy two-stage strategic bombardment missiles with massive fragmentation warheads that blanket large areas in lethal shrapnel.
Fires a salvo of four long-range fragmentation missiles, devastating unshielded escorts and civilian vessels across broad orbital sectors.
A compact flak projector mounted in an armored housing for close-in missile and fighter defense.
A triple-barrel flak projector providing reliable point-defense coverage against dense missile barrages.
A compact self-guided kinetic kill vehicle utilizing a miniature weaponized Alcubierre drive to achieve terrifying terminal acceleration against shielded targets.
A heavy Alcubierre-accelerated kinetic missile capable of crushing capital ship shields in a single relativistic impact.
""...I wouldn't call it a precision weapon, but against slow targets? It'll do just fine.""
""It's harder than you'd think to make high-output lasers. So you take three smaller lasers, and you focus them on the exact same spot. Easier to cool, and great at melting armor.""
""...in some tactical contexts, however, it's always acceptable to spray and pray.""
text2: - Breaching Tactics: A Small Unit Handbook

text1: ""Bravery has little to do with it. You get in the cockpit, and you roll the dice. Talent is simply a matter of not rolling snake eyes—plus good publicity.""
text2: - Attributed to Magellan fighter ace Maeillen Sxown

text1: ""Above a critical threshold, any deficits in armor penetration can be overcome by sheer, unrelenting volume of fire.""
""...we shall be as fetters about the feet of the mighty, harrying them night and day with cries for justice.""
""...just scaled it up, and decided all the design flaws and unintended consequences were features.""
text2: - Production Report on Heavy Energy Mounts

text1: ""The gun they want is so power hungry, it's even odds whether the enemy or our own flux grid blows up first. Honestly makes me wonder what the higher-ups at Fleet are thinking.""
""A sharpshooter's job is not merely to shoot, but to see clearly from a distance.""
text2: - Breaching Tactics: A Small Unit Handbook

text1: ""There is no power in the universe more steadfast and terrible than the voice of the people speaking up to say: Enough.""
""The oppressor swings their hammer to and fro against every stinging insect. We are more nimble.""
""...one of these days, people are gonna get tired of livin' in underground tunnels and eatin' recycled waste, and they're not gonna write polite letters about it, neither.""
text2: - Overheard in a Jeshad Tramway Tunnel

A launch tube for Strikefire MRMs, holding six rounds in a compact internal magazine.
""The line between field innovation and reckless disregard for crew safety isn't always clear—but I think we can all agree which side of that line this monstrosity falls on.""
text2: - Fleet War College Research Report on Improvised Weaponry

text1: ""Oh good. So you made a weapon so volatile that everything in the vicinity of the bore catches chunks of radioactive shrapnel? Slow clap, everybody. This lab's got a rising star!""
""...at this point I ceased argument with the Herdmaster, and shot him in the stomach.""
text2: - After-Action Report, Karic System Blackcollar Detachment

""This weapon really ought to be in a museum somewhere—from the look of it, it dates back to manufacturing patterns that originated on Old Earth itself...""

A heavy cruiser-integrated missile array firing Glowtide SRMs in broad saturation spreads. Inflicts severe initial damage followed by corrosive radiation over time, mitigated by armor.

""There's a time and a place for subtlety, but there's never a bad time to throw something loud, explosive, and fast, right at the other guy's faceplate.""
text2: - Breaching Tactics: A Small Unit Handbook

text1: An integrated missile tube that steadily fabricates and launches tandem shaped-charge Stunfire rockets to punch through heavy armor plating.
A simple rack holding three Stunfire anti-armor rockets.
A dual rack of Stunfire rocket grenades fired in pairs to crack armor during attack runs.
A flush-mounted micro-lens array projecting rapid pulsed energy beams dedicated to vaporizing incoming missile salvos and kinetic projectiles.

""That's a big old gun—bet you can hear the switches go 'clunk' when it fires. Ludd knows how bad it'll stress the flux frame, but looks even meaner than a Gauss Cannon if you're on the business end.""
""Only way something that small can throw a slug that fast is the integrated mount; try putting that on a modular fitting and it'll rip itself loose in a couple of shots.""
A low-powered optical and sensor illumination beam designed to paint target hulls and improve telemetry for allied gunners.

""There's violent, there's crude, and there's heaps of fun. In this business, you get the glorious privilege to fire weapons that are all three at once, with whipped cream and a big red cherry on top.""
""...I'm not totally sure what just happened there, but it was really loud, and I don't see the target anymore, so I guess it worked!""
A quad mounting of the Flenser CIWS system capable of laying down a continuous wall of explosive ordnance to eliminate missile swarms and shred light armor.
An ancient particle lance developed before modern shield technology became widespread, dealing devastating damage to exposed armor and bare hull.
""How much armor had to be removed to install these? And they use how much power? For what they're worth, these lances had better blow gaping holes through both sides of a war drone.""

text1: ""The eggheads insist the weapons on this ship are state-of-the-art, bleeding-edge technology, and while that may be true, I can tell you with assurity that an actual engineer hasn't been within a lightyear of these things.""
text2: - Reconstructed Audio Log, Presumed Captain Canady

A compact and terrifying shotgun flinging a dense cloud of spent radioactive fuel pellets to shred armor at point-blank range.
""I know the Herdmaster is a demanding man, but if you keep askin' me for 'demonstrations', I'll have to give you one from the business end of this piece.""
text2: - Tai Cor-Lan to the Herdmaster's Majordomo

text3: Disperses a field of electron charges that scramble sensors and confuse incoming guided missiles.

text1: Broadcasts real-time battle-grid telemetry to active strike wings, boosting fighter damage, speed, and defensive coordination.
text3: Sends real-time combat data to carrier strike wings, temporarily boosting their weapon damage, speed, and defensive reflexes.

text1: Supercharges a Swarmfighter drone with high-energy flux, sending it to detonate against a target for massive explosive damage.
text3: Supercharges a Swarmfighter drone and sends it after a target. Deals 500 High Explosive damage plus 500 Fragmentation damage on impact.

text1: Diverts reactor power to weapon autoloaders and energy capacitors, dramatically boosting fire rate and damage at the expense of mobility.
text3: Diverts reactor output to ammunition feed lines and capacitors, boosting ballistic fire rate and energy damage while reducing speed and agility. Prolonged overuse causes a full overload.

text1: Fires a radial barrage of proximity-fused flak canisters to eliminate surrounding threats.
text3: Fires a radial barrage of flak canisters with variable-timed proximity fuses. Each canister deals 150 High Explosive damage.

text1: Deploys proximity-fused flak canisters to screen strike craft from counter-missile fire.
text3: Deploys proximity-fused flak canisters around the strike craft, each dealing 150 High Explosive damage in an area.

text1: A jewel-like ocean world, home to the ruling aristocracy of the Magellan Protectorate. Enormous, semi-mobile platforms support glorious arcology-estates drifting lazily over brilliant azure waters, guarded by orbital defense grids.
text3: A shining blue marble around Magella's orange vastness, Annore is a world at once beautiful and forbidding; the spires of her ethereal ocean estates gleam bright, almost obscuring the long, questing muzzles of STO rocket-gun batteries that interrogate the heavens for outsider mischief. The good life is on display here; a rich, aristocratic tradition of plenty and sophistication by Sector standards. Mute personal servants and whimsical automatons scamper after every citizen's whim and fancy, and high technology invisibly secures a vast array of privileges for those honored to call themselves Citizens of Annore. The Protectorate's ruling class forms yet another tier of rarefied aristocratic power and status, above even the citizenry of this hermetic paradise.

text1: A bustling commercial starport and government convocation hub serving the aristocratic paradise of Annore below.
text3: A combination of commercial starport and vast government structure, Annore Orbital is home to the twice-yearly Convocation, in which the leading families of Annore gather to divide the material spoils of a brutally pointed social pyramid. The bacchanal atmosphere suffuses the station the rest of the year round; a 'trip upstairs', as the locals call it, is almost always an occasion for debauchery and dissipated excess.

text1: A parched desert planet whose polar hive-cities provide the manpower and industrial muscle that keeps the Magellan Protectorate functioning.
text3: A desperately dry, overpopulated world, Jeshad is the manpower reserve that keeps the Magellan state afloat; recruits for the Fleet and the Protector's Army are levied on Jeshad, offering pay and benefits that seem munificent to the inhabitants of the crowded, parched hive-cities that ring the cooler poles. Nomadic raiders travel the great equatorial deserts, raiding outlying settlements and skirmishing with one another using everything from primitive chemical firearms to surprisingly modern energy weaponry. Each clan hews to no law but their own in the fleets of armored rovers they call home, while their punctiliousness in matters of honor and cut-throat competition for resources have made them both highly fractious and highly skilled. Attempts to recruit the desert nomads for the Fleet have been a mixed success; some of the greatest Magellan heroes and worst mutineers have hailed from the deep deserts of Jeshad.

text1: A massive gas giant whose vibrant bands light up the night sky of Khamn, heavily harvested for volatile fuels by hardy gas-skimmer crews.
text3: Majestic and hazardous in equal measure, Magella is intensively mined for volatiles by a small flotilla of independent gas harvesters; every now and then, one of the ill-maintained, scrappy craft will plummet into the roiling cloudbanks in a shower of light and screaming metal.

text1: A barren, cratered world hosting the massive antimatter fuel production refineries of the Tichel Mercantile Concern.
text3:
Pariya's spaceport is constantly crowded by a flock of small, ramshackle mining craft from nearby Magella, who are forced to dock here and sell their meager cache of volatiles to the sole authorized buyer in the Protectorate. Yet this inter-system trade is a mere sideshow to the steady imports arriving from further afield, a trade likewise dominated entirely by the Tichel Mercantile Concern.

The rugged, spartan fuel production bases and outlying security outposts on Pariya's surface look and feel far more like a military outpost than a commercial endeavor; armed guards in the gray and gold uniform of the Tichel Yellowtails are everywhere, ready to harass workers and independent spacers alike with obnoxious eagerness.

text1: A temperate desert world home to thriving heavy manufacturing complexes and dissident agricultural domes.
text3: Unlike the vastly less hospitable colony of Valca, the rift valleys and deeper craters of Turan are shirt-sleeve habitable by human beings, albeit with breath masks for anything longer than a quick hike. A competitive industrial sector and hardy farming domes ensure that the planetary government is merely subservient to the Magellan governing structure that dominates local space; interference in local affairs is rare, and the smarter locals work to keep it that way.

text1: A fortified orbital customs station sustaining the planetary defense grid of Turan.
text3: This small port is vastly overshadowed by Meetpoint Turan, and spacers avoid docking here if possible in favor of the larger, more favorable free station in higher orbit.

text1: A frozen tundra world rich in volatile gases, colonized under harsh conditions and serving as a cradle for worker discontent.
text3: A frozen world with rich deposits of volatiles, Valca was colonized to supply the Fleet's new fuel production facilities and just as quickly became a hotbed of dissent; the solution was to declare the planet nominally independent, and lock the new government into a highly favorable contract for volatile supply. Port controls and the station in orbit keep trouble that brews on the surface contained there, while poverty and the harsh surface conditions impose their own kind of order on any exiles looking to return home at the head of a revolution.

text1: A massive military fortress orbiting Valca, maintaining strict surveillance over the volatile extraction facilities and turbulent local population.
text3: A veritable sword of Damocles hanging over the planet below, Valca Bastion stands ready to intervene at a moment's notice if the supply of volatiles to Pariya should ever come under serious threat. The garrison here is well-paid, but has relatively few options for off-shift activities; predictably, there's a thriving culture of heavy binge-drinking and petty violence in addition to the usual run of officially-sanctioned leisure.

text1: An obsolete starport converted into a free-trade bazaar, headquarters for independent merchant guilds and privateers operating outside Fleet jurisdiction.
text3: While Magellan space could hardly be called a commercial paradise, what trade in the local volume of space that can be called independent is headquartered here—a ramshackle, swapmeet-freeport where every ship's deck is a law unto itself and no sensible spacer gets between two crews with a grudge. Captains who dock here are notorious for accepting little to no restraint on their trade, their movements, and their much-touted customary rights to refuse inspection, declaration, or taxation on their cargoes. Many are little better than pirates, given half an opportunity and a halfway-plausible letter of marque or 'militia' licensure, and much of the trade that goes through here is as much about goods fenced as goods exchanged.

text1: A barren planetoid sheltering a fortified swapmeet and illicit black market beneath thick layers of armored regolith.
text3: Almost nothing about this planetesimal is in any way remarkable; it's purely interesting due to the dug-in pirate base that sits under thick layers of compacted regolith and metalloceramic armor. In spite, rather than because, of this excessive dedication to protection, the locals are more paranoid than usual; fears of a strike on unprotected domes by the Fleet or a local militia are supplanted or augmented by fears of internal power struggles to control a desirable base of operations.

text1: A bleak, abandoned penal rock once used by the Fleet to detain dangerous political dissidents before falling to open revolt.
text3: The base here was mainly constructed of pressurized fabric anti-rad domes, supported by flexible aluminum girders; little of either survived the revolt. A few twisted scraps of metal and desiccated plasticloth are all that remain near the sputtering landing beacon.

text1: A massive ancient sporeship hull from the original exile fleet, fortified into the sovereign military stronghold and staging base of the Blackcollar Regiment.
text3: The ancient sporeship hulk known as Crucible Base has been retrofitted by the Blackcollar Regiment into a formidable orbital fortress and logistics hub. While part of the vessel remains consecrated as a solemn memorial tomb to generations of fallen soldiers, its gargantuan interior bays now house active munitions foundries, heavy staging docks, and elite shock-trooper barracks. Spacers and licensed privateers permitted to dock here will find a well-supplied arms market offering upgraded warships, experimental weaponry, and combat LPCs rarely sanctioned for the civilian fleet.

text1: A hidden redoubt, command post, and shipyard of the Leveller underground nestled deep within the electromagnetic turbulence of the Rose Nebula.
text3: Once thought to be an abandoned casualty of the first Leveller Uprising, Rosebriar Station has been secretly revitalized and expanded into the Leveller movement's primary sanctuary and operations hub. Hidden beneath the dense plasma sheets and dust storms of the Rose Nebula, the station houses weapon modification workshops, clandestine printing suites, and refit berths for turncoat warships. While the central memorial hall preserves the sacred memories of past revolutions, the station's concourses hum with revolutionary fervor, barter trade, and insurgent logistics.

text1: A storm-scoured toxic world housing the industrial heart of the Herd, where outlaw refineries and illicit ship-breaking yards operate under caustic skies.
text3: Acrid is a harsh, poison-soaked world whose dense acidic atmosphere and violent chemical storms would deter any lawful enterprise. For the Herd, however, its deep volcanic craters and abundant heavy ores provide the ideal secluded cradle for illicit manufacturing. Massive geothermal smelters and scrap foundries churn day and night, producing crude armor plating, high-explosive ordnance, and makeshift strikecraft to fuel the raider fleets that terrorize the surrounding systems.

text1: An intensely irradiated desert world whose subterranean complexes and canyon redoubts serve as the primary fleet bastion and command lair of the Herd.
text3: Blistered by relentless solar radiation and geothermal heat, the surface of Scorched is lethal to unprotected life. Beneath its jagged obsidian canyons and basalt shields, however, lies an extensive warren of blast-hardened subterranean bunkers and drydocks. From this fortified lair, Herd warlords coordinate deep-space ambushes and maintain heavily modified combat vessels, protected from orbital surveillance by thick layers of lead-rich regolith.

text1: A frozen, airless rock at the edge of Dunerunner's Rest, functioning as a forward listening post, missile depot, and raider staging facility for the Herd.
text3: Cold, desolate, and heavily pitted by ancient meteor impacts, Desolation sits in silent vigil on the outer rim of Dunerunner's Rest. Its subsurface silos hold stockpiles of volatile munitions, auxiliary fuel reserves, and automated defense batteries. Fast attack flotillas and scavenger wolfpacks frequently stage from Desolation's subterranean docking bays before launching lightning raids into the Core Systems.

text1: A rugged frontier world of vast steppe ranches and outlaw syndicates, thriving as an anarchic freeport where any spacer is welcome.
text3: Too poor and too marginal to justify the returns, Calicheman has never been worth bringing under any kind of central control; neither the Magellan Protectorate nor any organized independent government or corporation can profitably control the planet, and so far none have been unwise enough to try. This suits the prickly locals just fine; few enough of them care about the wider galaxy unless it has something to trade for hides and jerky.

text1: A sprawling scrapyard fortress refitted as the headquarters for salvage syndicates and black-market arms dealers at Ghammol Station.
text3: Already marginal when the easy pickings of the local belt were exhausted, this once-promising mining facility in the inner system fell to a revolt and was swiftly abandoned to its fate by a Fleet that had no need of the meager trickle of resources it was by then bringing in. In a brief fit of high-minded moralism, it was renamed Ghammol Station after an outback town razed by the Blackcollars during the first Leveller Uprising.

text1: A notorious pirate haven and shadow port established within an abandoned Fleet early-warning station, home to contraband syndicates and revolutionaries.
text3: Every society has an underbelly, and Magellan society has more than most; Port Obilo's ramshackle concourses house everything from the most incorrigible career criminals to naive Leveller revolutionaries. All the inhabitants really have in common is their inability to make lives for themselves on either Annore or Jeshad, and fights are common, but they're in agreement on one point; the station batteries and minefields that keep the Fleet at bay must be maintained, whatever the cost.

text1: An ancient emergency distress beacon automatically deployed from an early-generation colonial vessel, possessing an ultra-reliable solid-state power cell built to transmit across millennia.
text3: An ancient automated distress transponder whose signal has pulsed through the vacuum for centuries. Astute commanders will often find valuable relic salvage and abandoned cargo pods in close proximity.

text1: An automated supply barge from the original Magellan exile fleet, battered by centuries of interstellar micro-meteorites and cosmic radiation.
text3: Hundreds of these automated logistics barges accompanied the exile fleet across the void to deliver critical replacement parts and sustenance. Though battered and unresponsive, salvage crews can still extract valuable pre-Collapse alloys and machine tooling from their hulls.

text1: A colossal Alcubierre-drive sleeper colony ship from the dawn of the Magellan migration, built with multi-redundant hull framing and primitive autofactories.
text3: Triply- and quadruply-redundant in all major systems and built to withstand centuries of continuous sub-light drift, these massive colony ships brought the Magellan exiles across the interstellar void. This weathered hulk preserves dormant technologies and manufacturing schematics from an era before the Collapse.

text1: A legendary flagship hulk from the original exile fleet, protected by massive composite armor plates and housing cavernous relic fabrication bays.
text3: One of the grand colonial motherships that spearheaded the great exodus from the Domain. These colossal vessels possessed self-contained industrial infrastructure to birth new civilizations in the void. Though battered by centuries of exposure, deep exploration of its interior bays can yield forgotten schematics and relic technologies.

text1: A militaristic, caste-bound society founded by an STL refugee fleet fleeing a distant Domain suppression campaign prior to the formal colonization of the Persean Sector. Trapped for generations in heavily armored sporeships, the exiles developed a rigid social hierarchy, a fiercely inward-looking culture, and an unwavering commitment to self-reliance. Guided by the High Protector and fortified by a unique technological lineage of rugged ballistics and microwave masers, the Magellan Protectorate stands as an unyielding bulwark against external encroachment.

A ferocious, radioactive pirate coalition originating from the untamed steppes of Calicheman. Operating heavily modified, scrap-plated warships armed with gamma torches and explosive flechettes, the Herd preys upon trade routes across the Khamn cluster with unbridled aggression and savage cunning.

A radical egalitarian revolutionary movement fighting to abolish the Protectorate's rigid caste system and aristocratic privileges. Operating from hidden sanctuaries like Rosebriar Station, the Levellers utilize automated drone networks, converted freighters, and asymmetric guerrilla tactics to wage an unrelenting war for total social liberation.

The premier shock marine regiment and heavy assault vanguard of the Magellan Protectorate. Operating from the fortified spore-fortress of Crucible Base, the Blackcollars field hardened, heavily armored warships with integrated assault bays, spearheading high-risk planetary breaches and orbital suppression operations.

The armed privateering, escort, and security arm of the Tichel Mercantile Concern. Based out of the massive antimatter refineries on Pariya, the Yellowtails deploy fast blockade runners, heavily armed freighters, and precision beam escorts to aggressively protect corporate monopolies across the sector.

The elite royal aerospace guard tasked with the defense of Annore and high-value orbital infrastructure. Piloting high-performance interceptors, upgraded strike corvettes, and agile carrier wings, the Skytigers maintain absolute space superiority over the Protectorate's core worlds.

Direct descendants of the original voidfarers and sleeper crews who piloted the exile fleet from the Domain. Operating from self-contained dome complexes on Turan, they safeguard archaic survey technologies, ancestral navigation charts, and ancient colonial traditions.

Independent asteroid miners, wreck-breakers, and civilian salvage crews operating across the debris fields of the Khamn cluster, trading raw ores and reclaimed components with any port offering fair exchange.

Centuries-old automated defense automata and emergency AI cores still guarding the drifting hulks of the original Magellan exile fleet. Programmed to defend their ancestral wrecks against all intruders, they operate with cold, unwavering precision.

Free merchants, independent spacers, and guild captains operating outside the direct command of the High Protector, headquartered at Meetpoint Turan where the Guild of Free Traders ensures open commerce across the frontier.
